editorial_policy: Observed conditions, provider activity, official targets, programme claims and juristic classifications must never be conflated. These records are research hypotheses, not verdicts or endorsements.

sufficiency_taxonomy.documented_target_gap: Official provider capacity is below a source-defined numerical target; does not settle service adequacy or legal duty.
sufficiency_taxonomy.baseline_and_activity: Independent baseline and separate provider output present; not linkable to service adequacy.
sufficiency_taxonomy.outcome_only: Evidence of outcome concern, but supply, access, and effective alternatives remain unclear.
sufficiency_taxonomy.campaign_only: Campaign narrative only; independent validation missing.

assessments.title: Penang: household security and welfare provision
assessments.review_status: Partial: documented condition and distribution, no coverage conclusion
assessments.normative_question: What duties of provision, zakat administration and protection of those in need bear upon different actors? Farḍ kifāya cannot be inferred from a poverty percentage alone.

observations.label: Households below the official absolute poverty line

assessments.what_is_known: A measured poverty incidence and an aggregate administrative account of zakat distribution are both available. The MASA@Sungai Nibong study describes a targeted household-centred intervention through waqf-linked accommodation, training and continued support.
assessments.what_is_not_known: The two sources do not identify the same individual households, and their dates and concepts differ. There is no verified comparison of eligible household needs, benefit adequacy, exclusions, access, service quality or outcomes across the state. Recipient persons are not interchangeable with households. Zakat distribution is not the entire welfare system.
assessments.adequacy_standard: A defensible locally defined household sufficiency standard, distinguishing official poverty-line income from juristic and administrative ḥadd al-kifāyah criteria, plus evidence of accessible and reliable provision.
evidence_to_collect: The actual Penang zakat ḥadd al-kifāyah criteria and eligibility rules by household composition
Unduplicated numbers of eligible households, recipients, applicants and unsuccessful applicants
Value, duration, timing and material adequacy of assistance
Disaggregated local conditions, access barriers and non-zakat welfare provision
Independent household follow-up, financial durability and programme evaluations
proposed_contributions: Evaluate household adequacy rather than just funding volume
Improve case management and eligibility access
Mentor and train livelihood programme staff
cautions: Different population units and years must not be used as a coverage numerator and denominator
State statistics cannot certify the need of each locality or individual family
A qualitative case study does not demonstrate a causal state-wide impact

assessments.title: Malaysia: foundational learning and competent teaching
assessments.review_status: Outcome concern documented; provider sufficiency unknown
assessments.normative_question: Which forms of knowledge and educational provision are obligatory or otherwise needed, for which populations? PISA does not itself establish a particular Islamic legal classification.

observations.label: Reached at least PISA Level 2 in mathematics
Reached at least PISA Level 2 in reading
Reached at least PISA Level 2 in science

assessments.what_is_known: The OECD's 2025 PISA country note reports comparatively low shares of tested 15-year-olds attaining minimum proficiency in mathematics, reading and science. It includes comparisons to OECD averages and trend measures.
assessments.what_is_not_known: We do not know from this comparison which forms of provision are inadequate: teacher supply, instructional quality, curriculum alignment, household support, language factors, school access or other conditions. Nor can these results be transferred to a particular mosque school or specialised religious curriculum.
assessments.adequacy_standard: For the specified learner population, a defensible standard of learning, access and continuity, supplemented with relevant curricular and educational quality indicators; then assess what supply conditions would meet it.
evidence_to_collect: Subject-specific and locality-specific attainment with uncertainty estimates
Existing teaching capacity, qualifications, contact time, attendance and access
Curriculum quality, assessments, school support and effective interventions
Comparative evidence on teacher preparation and remediation
Longitudinal evaluation of proposed curricula and learner development
proposed_contributions: Pilot and evaluate targeted teaching materials
Train practitioners in diagnosis and remediation
Support qualified curriculum development and teacher mentorship
Avoid launching a new institution until its comparative advantage is demonstrated
cautions: PISA proficiency is a specific assessment construct, not the whole of education
A low learning outcome is not necessarily a teacher headcount shortage
National sample data do not measure access or outcomes in a particular subcommunity

assessments.title: Malaysia: mental-health care and specialist capacity
assessments.population: Adults and the public psychiatric system
assessments.review_status: Documented ministry psychiatrist ratio below stated target; broader access unresolved
assessments.normative_question: Which necessary forms of clinical provision and prevention of grave harm require collective or public arrangements, and through which qualified institutions?
assessments.what_is_known: NHMS 2023 provides a population-health indicator. The Ministry of Health reported 445 ministry psychiatrists and a psychiatrist-to-population ratio of 1:69,860, below its target of 1:40,000, alongside 40 MENTARI centres as of 1 April 2026.
assessments.what_is_not_known: The figures do not quantify national unmet episodes of treatment, staffing of non-MOH providers, patient waiting times, distribution across regions, quality of multidisciplinary care or treatment outcomes.
assessments.adequacy_standard: Clearly defined access, clinical quality, safe referral and appropriate specialist capacity, including the ministry workforce benchmark as one partial indicator rather than a complete sufficiency criterion.
evidence_to_collect: Public and private specialist services by district and population
Service volumes, wait times, referrals and discontinuation rates
Case-mix, supervision, staffing distribution and multidisciplinary capacity
Patient outcomes and appropriate safeguarding
Professional training and retention data with local underserved subpopulations
provider_types: Primary care and social care partners
proposed_contributions: Increase appropriate specialist training and supervision
Improve equitable access, referrals and service continuity
Support independent quality and workforce evaluation
Establish services only after feasibility and workforce planning
cautions: The government target does not, on its own, constitute a juridically binding threshold
Ministry staff numbers do not measure every provider or service
A prevalence survey and workforce target are complementary, not directly interchangeable denominators

assessments.title: Bangi: educational crowdfunding as a field-research lead
assessments.population: Children described by a closed campaign
assessments.review_status: Organiser claims only; no independent local need or effect established
assessments.normative_question: Does the necessary educational provision for identified learners require additional capacity, and are the proposed classes an effective and permissible response?

observations.label: Qurʾān classes stated by campaign organiser
Science and mathematics classes stated by organiser

assessments.what_is_known: A closed LaunchGood appeal by Pertubuhan Kecemerlangan Pendidikan Ummah describes free education and support for children described as asnaf and poor, and advertises Qurʾān, science and mathematics provision.
assessments.what_is_not_known: The campaign claims have not been independently audited here. We lack dated enrolment registers, verified learning outcomes, coverage, cost per learner, learner retention, programme capacity, and evidence of alternative services. This is not a current opportunity or donation recommendation.
assessments.adequacy_standard: Age-appropriate, competent, accessible learning with meaningful progress, protection and continuity for a clearly defined beneficiary population.
evidence_to_collect: Independent verification of participants, locations and teaching credentials
Educational baselines, comparable alternatives and accessibility barriers
Outcomes, retention, family needs and costs
Evidence of sustained institutional capacity and safeguarding
Applicable zakat/charity eligibility and legal compliance
proposed_contributions: Observe or audit provision before recommending expansion
Improve learning evaluation and teacher formation
Assess family needs alongside instructional support
cautions: Organiser-reported campaign quantities are not validated indicators of demand or impact
Campaign is marked closed; no current donation opportunity is claimed
Location of campaign impact does not prove every reported class is in the same district
